_meta.source: Draft lead rules after the Oct 28 meeting: fit comes from project type and investment together, leads are hot, warm or cold, and location plays no part. Every amount and warning sign is a guess and must be reviewed by Banfield (see 'To validate at a future meeting' in docs/DISCOVERY.md).
_meta.labels: hot = a great fit; warm = worth a call, check on it; cold = likely not a fit, or not yet. Labels are team-facing only and never shown to the client.
_meta.projectQuestion: The question id for project type. Every answer to it needs an entry in 'thresholds'; the app will not start if one is missing.
_meta.investmentQuestion: The question id for the investment slider.
_meta.thresholds: Investment amounts per project type. At or above 'hotFrom' is hot, at or above 'warmFrom' is warm, anything lower is cold. 'hotFrom' must not be below 'warmFrom'.
_meta.unsureStart: The starting label when the project type is skipped, or the investment is skipped or 'Not sure yet'.
_meta.details: Answers listed in the brief's lead section for context. They never change the label.
_meta.redFlags: Warning signs shown in the brief. A sign is raised when every condition in 'when' matches. Any raised sign lowers the label one step (hot to warm, warm to cold), never more than one step.
